raw.query: SELECT model, mode, sum(n_origins) FROM (SELECT model, mode, resolution, count(distinct origin) AS n_origins FROM provenance.forecast WHERE model IN ('timesfm', 'chronos', 'toto') GROUP BY model, mode, resolution) t GROUP BY model, mode ORDER BY model, mode;
